descriptionStrong: This category of action is denied by default. Even on a local machine with someone watching, it can only be force-confirmed individually — it can never be set to always allow.
understandRisk: I understand the risk, allow anyway…
confirmAllowOnce: Click again to confirm: allow this action once
hardDenyBadge: Writes outside the worktree, reads of secret paths, force-push, and similar actions are always hard-denied

remember.chooseScope: Choose the scope to remember (narrowest selected by default):
remember.effectiveNote: Takes effect immediately after saving (no restart needed) — you can remove it later from the policy rules in settings.
remember.commandExactLabel: Allow only this exact command (narrowest, recommended)
remember.pathExactLabel: Allow only files under this directory (narrowest, recommended)
remember.pathWorkdirLabel: Allow files anywhere under the worktree (broader)
